name: nginx
description: The official NGINX Open Source repository.
one_liner: The web server software that quietly runs a huge share of the internet's traffic behind the scenes — it routes requests to the right place and serves pages fast.
buyer: Honestly, not a buyer for a new indie business — nginx itself is free, mature, core infrastructure already bundled everywhere; the only real opportunity is in services built around it, not the software itself.
business_use_cases: A managed-hosting company sells 'nginx configured and hardened for you' as a line item to small businesses afraid of config files.
A security consultant audits and hardens client nginx configs against common misconfiguration exploits.
An infra-as-a-service startup builds a friendly dashboard on top of raw nginx config for non-technical site owners.

money_ideas.idea: Offer one-off nginx config audits and hardening for small businesses running their own servers.
Sell a subscription monitoring/alerting dashboard layered on top of nginx access logs.

steal_this: Package a dead-simple 'upload your nginx.conf, get a hardening report' web tool and charge a flat fee per scan.
